items.name: Macher jhol, rui (rohu)
items.notes: Thin turmeric-cumin gravy with potato; rohu in mustard oil. Varies with oil and potato.

items.name: Macher jhol, katla
items.notes: Thin gravy with potato; katla is a fattier carp. Varies with oil.

items.name: Macher jhol, bhetki (barramundi)
items.notes: Light ginger-cumin gravy; bhetki fillet pieces. Varies with oil.

items.name: Macher jhol, pabda
items.notes: Thin gravy with nigella and green chilli; small pabda pieces.

items.name: Macher jhol, tangra
items.notes: Thin gravy with tomato and potato; tangra catfish. Bones are included in the weight.

items.name: Macher jhol, magur (catfish)
items.notes: Light gravy with ginger and green chilli; magur catfish.

items.name: Macher jhol, koi (climbing perch)
items.notes: Thin gravy with onion and ginger; koi fish with bones.

items.name: Macher jhol, shol (snakehead)
items.notes: Light gravy with ginger and turmeric; shol snakehead pieces.

items.name: Macher jhol, parshe (mullet)
items.notes: Thin gravy with potato; parshe mullet, bones included.

items.name: Macher jhol, mourala (mola)
items.notes: Tiny fish cooked whole in light gravy; eaten whole with bones.

items.name: Macher jhol with cauliflower
items.notes: Fish pieces with cauliflower and potato in thin gravy.

items.name: Ilish macher jhol (hilsa curry with brinjal)
items.notes: Hilsa is oily; gravy with brinjal. Bones are included in the weight.

items.name: Shorshe ilish (hilsa in mustard)
items.notes: Hilsa in ground mustard, green chilli and mustard oil. Bones are included in the weight.

items.name: Bhapa ilish (steamed hilsa)
items.notes: Hilsa steamed with mustard paste and oil; bones included.

items.name: Ilish bhaja (fried hilsa)
items.notes: Shallow-fried hilsa in mustard oil; bones included. Oil absorbed varies.

items.name: Ilish paturi
items.notes: Hilsa with mustard-coconut paste steamed in banana leaf.

items.name: Bhetki paturi
items.notes: Bhetki fillet with mustard-coconut paste steamed in banana leaf.

items.name: Bhapa bhetki
items.notes: Bhetki steamed with mustard paste and mustard oil.

items.name: Bhapa chingri
items.notes: Prawns steamed in mustard-coconut paste.

items.name: Bhapa pabda
items.notes: Pabda steamed in mustard paste; bones included.

items.name: Bhapa rui
items.notes: Rohu steaks steamed in mustard paste.

items.name: Shorshe rui (rohu in mustard)
items.notes: Rohu in mustard gravy with mustard oil and green chilli.

items.name: Shorshe pabda
items.notes: Pabda in mustard gravy; bones included.

items.name: Shorshe tangra
items.notes: Tangra in mustard gravy; bones included.

items.name: Shorshe chingri (prawn in mustard)
items.notes: Prawns in mustard gravy with mustard oil.

items.name: Macher kalia, rui
items.notes: Rich onion-ginger-tomato gravy with fried rohu; varies with oil.

items.name: Macher kalia, katla
items.notes: Rich gravy with fried katla; varies with oil.

items.name: Macher kofta curry (Bengali fish balls)
items.notes: Fish and potato balls fried and simmered in gravy.

items.name: Macher chop (fish croquette)
items.notes: Fish and potato croquette, crumbed and fried. Oil varies.

items.name: Macher bhaja, rui (fried rohu)
items.notes: Rohu steaks shallow-fried with turmeric and salt in mustard oil.

items.name: Macher bhaja, katla (fried katla)
items.notes: Katla steaks shallow-fried; oil absorbed varies.

items.name: Macher bhaja, parshe (fried mullet)
items.notes: Small mullet shallow-fried; bones included.

items.name: Mourala macher bhaja (fried small fish)
items.notes: Tiny fish fried crisp and eaten whole.

items.name: Bhetki fish fry, Kolkata style
items.notes: Crumbed bhetki fillet fried; restaurant estimate. Oil and coating vary.

items.name: Fish kabiraji
items.notes: Bhetki fillet in lacy egg batter, fried; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Chingri malaikari
items.notes: Prawns in coconut milk gravy; varies with coconut milk and ghee.

items.name: Daab chingri (prawn in green coconut)
items.notes: Prawns steamed in a tender coconut; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Lau chingri
items.notes: Bottle gourd with small prawns in light gravy.

items.name: Chingri posto
items.notes: Prawns in poppy seed paste with mustard oil.

items.name: Kakrar jhal (crab curry)
items.notes: Crab pieces in spicy gravy; shell is not eaten, so weigh the cooked meat and gravy only.

items.name: Muri ghonto (fish head with rice)
items.notes: Fish head cooked with gobindobhog rice and ghee.

items.name: Shutki bhuna (dried fish masala)
items.notes: Dried fish fried with onion and chilli; strong flavour, eaten in small amounts.

items.name: Macher chorchori
items.notes: Fish pieces with mixed vegetables and mustard paste.

items.name: Aloo posto
items.notes: Potato cooked in poppy seed paste with mustard oil.

items.name: Jhinge posto
items.notes: Ridge gourd in poppy seed paste.

items.name: Potol posto
items.notes: Pointed gourd in poppy seed paste.

items.name: Begun posto
items.notes: Brinjal in poppy seed paste.

items.name: Posto bora
items.notes: Poppy seed and onion balls, deep fried; oil varies.

items.name: Shukto
items.notes: Bitter gourd, drumstick, banana and other vegetables in milk and mustard paste.

items.name: Dhokar dalna
items.notes: Fried chana dal cakes simmered in gravy.

items.name: Labra
items.notes: Bengali mixed vegetable with panch phoron; no onion or garlic in the temple style.

items.name: Chorchori, mixed vegetable
items.notes: Mixed vegetable and stalk dish with mustard paste.

items.name: Chechki, vegetable
items.notes: Dry sauteed vegetables and thin sticks with panch phoron.

items.name: Panchmishali torkari
items.notes: Five or more vegetables cooked together with light spices.

items.name: Mochar ghonto (banana flower)
items.notes: Banana flower with potato, coconut and chana dal.

items.name: Thorer ghonto (banana stem)
items.notes: Banana stem with potato and coconut.

items.name: Echorer dalna (raw jackfruit curry)
items.notes: Raw jackfruit in spiced gravy; varies with oil.

items.name: Kochur loti (colocasia stolon curry)
items.notes: Colocasia stolons cooked with coconut or dried shrimp.

items.name: Kochu shak
items.notes: Colocasia leaves in mustard-coconut paste.

items.name: Lau ghonto
items.notes: Bottle gourd with chana dal and potato.

items.name: Begun bhaja
items.notes: Brinjal slices shallow-fried; oil absorbed varies a lot.

items.name: Beguni (brinjal fritter)
items.notes: Brinjal slice in besan batter, deep fried.

items.name: Begun bharta, Bengali
items.notes: Roasted brinjal mashed with mustard oil, onion and chilli.

items.name: Potoler dorma
items.notes: Pointed gourd stuffed with paneer or fish and cooked in gravy.

items.name: Potol bhaja
items.notes: Pointed gourd slices shallow-fried.

items.name: Uchche bhaja
items.notes: Thin bitter gourd rounds fried; usually the first course.

items.name: Kumro bhaja
items.notes: Pumpkin pieces shallow-fried.

items.name: Kumro chhokka
items.notes: Pumpkin with panch phoron, light on spices.

items.name: Palong shak bhaja
items.notes: Spinach stir fried with garlic and dried red chilli.

items.name: Kolmi shak bhaja
items.notes: Water spinach stir fried with garlic.

items.name: Pui shak chorchori
items.notes: Malabar spinach with stems and brinjal, mustard oil.

items.name: Fulkopir dalna
items.notes: Cauliflower and potato in light gravy.

items.name: Bandhakopir ghonto
items.notes: Cabbage with peas and potato, panch phoron.

items.name: Chhanar dalna
items.notes: Fried chhena cubes in light gravy with potato.

items.name: Aloor dom, Bengali
items.notes: Small potatoes in spiced gravy; usual side for luchi.

items.name: Aloo bhaja
items.notes: Fine potato sticks shallow-fried; oil varies.

items.name: Aloo seddho makha
items.notes: Boiled potato mashed with mustard oil, onion and chilli.

items.name: Tomato khejur amshotto chutney
items.notes: Tomato, dates and dried mango sweet chutney served at the end of a meal.

items.name: Kancha aam chutney (raw mango)
items.notes: Raw mango cooked with sugar and panch phoron.

items.name: Pepe chutney (raw papaya)
items.notes: Raw papaya cooked with sugar, raisins and panch phoron.

items.name: Amer ombol (sweet-sour mango)
items.notes: Thin sweet-sour raw mango dish; sugar varies.

items.name: Anarosher chutney (pineapple)
items.notes: Pineapple cooked with sugar, raisins and spices.

items.name: Kul chutney (jujube)
items.notes: Jujube cooked sweet and sour with mustard oil.

items.name: Cholar dal
items.notes: Bengal gram dal with coconut pieces, ginger and ghee; eaten with luchi.

items.name: Cholar dal, plain (no coconut)
items.notes: Bengal gram dal tempered with cumin and bay leaf, no coconut.

items.name: Bhaja moong dal
items.notes: Dry-roasted moong dal cooked with ghee and ginger.

items.name: Masurer dal
items.notes: Red lentils tempered with nigella and chilli.

items.name: Tok dal
items.notes: Light tangy dal soured with tamarind or green mango.

items.name: Biulir dal
items.notes: Split black gram dal, thick, with asafoetida.

items.name: Sada mug dal
items.notes: Plain moong dal with turmeric and a light tempering.

items.name: Macher matha diye mug dal
items.notes: Moong dal cooked with fish head; bones are not included in the eating weight.

items.name: Luchi
items.notes: Deep-fried refined flour puffed bread; oil absorbed varies.

items.name: Radhaballabhi
items.notes: Luchi stuffed with spiced urad dal; deep fried.

items.name: Koraishutir kochuri
items.notes: Fried bread stuffed with green pea filling; winter special.

items.name: Dal kochuri, Bengali
items.notes: Fried bread with spiced dal filling.

items.name: Mughlai paratha, Kolkata style
items.notes: Egg-and-mince stuffed fried flatbread; street or restaurant estimate.

items.name: Basanti pulao
items.notes: Gobindobhog rice with ghee, saffron, raisins and a little sugar.

items.name: Mishti pulao
items.notes: Sweet pulao with ghee, cashew and raisins; sugar and ghee vary.

items.name: Chirer polao
items.notes: Flattened rice with peas, peanuts and ghee; winter breakfast.

items.name: Panta bhat
items.notes: Overnight water-soaked rice, eaten cold with onion, chilli and mustard oil (extra oil not included).

items.name: Bhoger khichuri
items.notes: Festival khichuri with roasted moong, ghee and vegetables.

items.name: Bhuna khichuri
items.notes: Roasted moong dal khichuri with onion and extra ghee.

items.name: Egg khichuri (dim khichuri)
items.notes: Khichuri with boiled eggs; values for the whole dish.

items.name: Chicken khichuri
items.notes: Khichuri cooked with chicken pieces.

items.name: Masoor dal khichuri
items.notes: Red lentil and rice khichuri with a light tempering.

items.name: Sabji khichuri (vegetable)
items.notes: Khichuri with cauliflower, peas, potato and carrot.

items.name: Kosha mangsho
items.notes: Slow-cooked dry mutton in onion-tomato masala; oil varies. Bones not in the weight.

items.name: Mangsher jhol
items.notes: Light mutton curry with potato; thinner than kosha mangsho.

items.name: Pathar jhol
items.notes: Light goat meat curry with potato and ginger.

items.name: Mutton rezala, Kolkata style
items.notes: Mutton in white yogurt-poppy gravy; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Mutton chaap, Kolkata style
items.notes: Marinated mutton chop cooked in rich gravy; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Murgir jhol
items.notes: Thin chicken curry with potato in mustard oil; skinless weight not assumed.

items.name: Murgir kosha
items.notes: Slow-cooked thick chicken masala in mustard oil.

items.name: Chicken rezala, Kolkata style
items.notes: Chicken in white yogurt-poppy gravy; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Chicken chaap, Kolkata style
items.notes: Marinated chicken piece cooked in rich gravy; restaurant estimate.

items.name: Dak bungalow chicken
items.notes: Chicken curry with potato and egg in a thin turmeric-chilli gravy.

items.name: Dimer dalna
items.notes: Boiled egg halves fried and simmered in tomato-potato gravy.

items.name: Dimer jhol
items.notes: Thin egg curry with potato; lighter than dimer dalna.

items.name: Dimer devil
items.notes: Boiled egg wrapped in spiced potato, crumbed and fried.

items.name: Dimer omlet, Bengali
items.notes: Two-egg omelette with onion and green chilli in mustard oil.

items.name: Haser dimer jhol (duck egg curry)
items.notes: Duck egg curry with potato; duck eggs are larger and richer than hen eggs.

items.name: Piyaji (onion fritter)
items.notes: Onion in besan batter, deep fried; oil varies.

items.name: Alur chop
items.notes: Spiced mashed potato ball with peanuts, crumbed and deep fried.

items.name: Mochar chop
items.notes: Banana blossom and potato croquette, fried.

items.name: Beetroot chop
items.notes: Beetroot and potato croquette with peanuts, deep fried.

items.name: Dimer chop (egg chop)
items.notes: Boiled egg in spiced potato covering, crumbed and fried.

items.name: Fuluri
items.notes: Small besan fritters, deep fried.

items.name: Kumro phuler bora
items.notes: Pumpkin flower in batter, fried; oil varies.

items.name: Bori bhaja (fried lentil dumpling)
items.notes: Dried lentil dumplings fried crisp; eaten as a small side.

items.name: Ghugni (yellow pea curry)
items.notes: Dried yellow peas cooked with onion and spices; street style is a bit oilier.

items.name: Aloo kabli
items.notes: Kolkata street chaat: potato and chickpeas with chutney; estimate.

items.name: Jhalmuri
items.notes: Puffed rice with peanuts, chanachur, onion and mustard oil; street estimate.

items.name: Nimki
items.notes: Small deep-fried flour diamonds with nigella; very energy dense.

items.name: Chanachur (Bengali spicy mix)
items.notes: Packaged fried gram-flour and lentil mix; brand and oil content vary.

items.name: Gondhoraj lebu sharbat
items.notes: Gondhoraj lime with sugar and water; sugar varies. Per 100 ml.

items.name: Lebu cha (lemon tea)
items.notes: Black tea with lemon and sugar; per 100 ml with about 1 tsp sugar per cup.

items.name: Sandesh, plain
items.notes: Fresh chhena and sugar; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Nolen gurer sandesh
items.notes: Chhena with winter date palm jaggery; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Kacha golla
items.notes: Soft unbaked chhena sweet; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Chocolate sandesh
items.notes: Chhena with cocoa and sugar; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Sitabhog
items.notes: Bardhaman sweet of rice-like strands with small gulab jamun; estimate.

items.name: Mihidana
items.notes: Tiny saffron boondi-like sweet; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Langcha
items.notes: Fried oblong chhena-khoa sweet in syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Pantua
items.notes: Fried chhena-khoa ball in syrup, close to gulab jamun; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Ledikeni
items.notes: Fried chhena sweet in syrup, named for Lady Canning; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Rasmalai
items.notes: Flattened chhena discs in sweetened thick milk; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Chamcham
items.notes: Oval chhena sweet in syrup, sometimes with khoa coating; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Raj bhog
items.notes: Large saffron chhena ball with nut filling in syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Kalo jam
items.notes: Dark fried khoa-chhena ball in syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Mishti doi
items.notes: Caramelised sweet set yogurt; sugar and milk fat vary by maker.

items.name: Payesh
items.notes: Gobindobhog rice slow-cooked in full-fat milk and sugar.

items.name: Nolen gurer payesh
items.notes: Rice and milk pudding with winter date palm jaggery.

items.name: Chanar payesh
items.notes: Chhena pieces in thickened sweet milk.

items.name: Kheer kadam
items.notes: Chhena ball coated with khoa, soaked in syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Gokul pithe
items.notes: Fried coconut and khoa dumpling in sugar syrup.

items.name: Narkel naru
items.notes: Coconut and jaggery or sugar laddu; sweetener varies.

items.name: Murir moa
items.notes: Puffed rice bound with jaggery syrup; winter sweet.

items.name: Joynagarer moa
items.notes: Kanakchur rice and nolen gur ball; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Darbesh
items.notes: Bengali boondi-style ball bound with sugar syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Chanar jilipi
items.notes: Chhena jalebi fried and soaked in syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Nolen gurer rasgulla
items.notes: Chhena balls in date palm jaggery syrup; Sweet-shop style; sugar, ghee and size vary.

items.name: Patishapta
items.notes: Thin rice-flour crepe rolled with coconut-jaggery or khoa filling.

items.name: Puli pithe
items.notes: Rice-flour dumpling with coconut-jaggery filling, boiled or in milk (milk not included).

items.name: Bhapa pithe
items.notes: Steamed rice-flour cake with coconut-jaggery filling.

items.name: Dudh puli
items.notes: Puli pithe simmered in sweetened milk.
